summary: create-remotion ships host reconnaissance and exfiltration to a hardcoded Zapier webhook
details: lib/report.js imports child_process, fs, https, and os and collects host identity and environment data via os.hostname(), os.userInfo(), execSync(...), and fs.readFileSync(...) calls at lines 20, 31, 72, 160 and 168. The collected data is sent via an https.request POST (lines 118, 121) to a hardcoded destination at hooks.zapier.com (line 12). The Zapier webhook is an author-controlled ingestion endpoint unrelated to any documented purpose of a create-remotion scaffolder, and the receiving of installer hostname, user info, and filesystem contents constitutes host reconnaissance and data exfiltration on install/run of the package.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
